cases.title: The same primary path on automationexercise.com works at a 768 px tablet width
cases.why: Width, orientation, and a touch scroll would be checked in Appium, Maestro, or a browser device profile on automationexercise.com.

cases.title: automationexercise.com/products, the slowest page analyzed, stays inside the same budget
cases.why: The slowest response on automationexercise.com was automationexercise.com/products at 987 ms, against 732 ms for automationexercise.com. The trend across the crawl is the order the pages were opened, not a history of previous days.

cases.title: The robots meta tag on automationexercise.com matches the pages that should be indexed
cases.why: The robots meta tag on automationexercise.com says index. The later case would compare it with the canonical URL. This review does not submit the page to a search engine.

cases.title: The h1 and the title on automationexercise.com agree
cases.why: The first h1 is "Automation Exercise" and the title is "Automation Exercise". The two do not have to be identical, and they should not describe different pages.

cases.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read automationexercise.com
cases.why: robots.txt on automationexercise.com would be read for OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot, and Claude-User. A full Disallow for any of them keeps automationexercise.com out of the answers that product writes. Training crawlers are a separate choice and are not asserted here.

cases.title: automationexercise.com still explains itself when scripts do not run
cases.why: No noscript element was found on automationexercise.com. The case would disable JavaScript and check that the title and the main heading remain.

cases.title: automationexercise.com renders the same in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
cases.why: Markers seen on automationexercise.com: jQuery, Bootstrap, Google Fonts, cloudflare, Phusion Passenger(R) 6.2.1. The case would open automationexercise.com in each engine and compare the title, the h1, and the primary link. A later cross-browser pass could use BrowserStack. It is not started here.

cases.title: An authorised load run on automationexercise.com holds under 1100 ms
cases.why: automationexercise.com answered in 732 ms to one request. JMeter, Gatling, or k6 would hold one request per second for a few minutes, ramp inside an agreed ceiling, and stop, failing above 1100 ms at the 95th percentile or 1% errors. It needs written permission, a verified domain, and a scheduled window. This review did not open a single virtual user.

tools.name: BrowserStack
tools.why: Browser cases are in this list. A later cross-browser pass could use BrowserStack. It is not started here.

tools.name: Applitools

tools.name: Percy

alerts.title: HSTS is absent
alerts.detail: The first response did not send strict-transport-security. A later visit can still be steered to plain http. This is a missing control. It is not proof that someone broke in.

alerts.title: A content security policy is absent
alerts.detail: The first response did not send content-security-policy. Script sources are not limited by that header. This is a missing control. It is not proof of an intrusion.

alerts.title: A cookie is missing Secure or HttpOnly
alerts.detail: 1 cookies on the first response lack Secure or HttpOnly. A session cookie in that state can be read by script or sent on plain http. This review did not use the cookie.

insights.summary: automationexercise.com scores 46 out of 100 (F). 8 checks fail now, 37 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

findings.title: HSTS is not sent
findings.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.
findings.fix: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains.

findings.title: 30 form controls have no label
findings.evidence: On /, /products, /view_cart, /login and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
findings.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

findings.title: The browser requested plain http resources
findings.evidence: http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto:400,300,400italic,500,700,100, http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Open+Sans:400,800,300,600,700, http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Abel and 3 more.
findings.fix: Load every resource over https.

findings.title: Buttons must have discernible text
findings.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /products, /view_cart, for example #subscribe. Impact: critical.
findings.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

findings.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 83 elements on /, /products, /view_cart, for example li:nth-child(1) > a[href="/"] and .features_items > .col-sm-4:nth-child(3) > .product-image-wrapper > .single-products > .productinfo.text-center > h2. Impact: serious.
findings.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

findings.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
findings.evidence: Without Secure: csrftoken. Without HttpOnly: csrftoken. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /products, /view_cart and 17 more.
findings.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

findings.title: 24 images are not served as WebP or AVIF
findings.evidence: 29 on / (JPEG, 604 KB), 11 on / (JPEG, 244 KB), 41 on / (JPEG, 210 KB), 21 on / (JPEG, 197 KB) and 20 more. WebP is about 30% smaller at the same quality, so about 901 KB could be saved.
findings.fix: Serve WebP or AVIF through the CDN or image service, or with <picture> and a JPEG or PNG fallback.

findings.title: Links must have discernible text
findings.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example .left.control-carousel.hidden-xs and .right.control-carousel.hidden-xs. Impact: serious.
findings.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

findings.title: No content security policy
findings.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
findings.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

findings.title: 18 images are more than twice the size shown
findings.evidence: 29 on / (1200×1600 shown at 247×330, 604 KB, about 501 KB to save), 11 on / (1600×1939 shown at 247×300, 244 KB, about 221 KB to save), 41 on / (1000×1500 shown at 247×371, 210 KB, about 159 KB to save), 21 on / (1000×1500 shown at 247×371, 197 KB, about 149 KB to save) and 14 more. About 2041 KB could be saved, keeping a 2× copy for sharp screens.
findings.fix: Resize images to at most twice the width they are shown at, and give phones smaller files with srcset and sizes.

findings.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
findings.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (21 requests), and cookies IDE on doubleclick.net, DSID on doubleclick.net.
findings.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

findings.title: 31 images below the first screen load straight away
findings.evidence: 4 on /, 5 on /, 6 on /, 7 on / and 27 more. They compete with the first screen for bandwidth.
findings.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the first screen, and keep it off the main image.

findings.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
findings.evidence: /, /products, /view_cart, /login and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
findings.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
findings.fix: Send Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=().

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
findings.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
findings.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

findings.title: 20 pages have no main landmark
findings.evidence: /, /products, /view_cart, /login and 16 more.
findings.fix: Wrap the primary content in <main>.

findings.title: 20 pages do not have exactly one h1
findings.evidence: / (3), /products (0), /view_cart (0), /login (0) and 16 more.
findings.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

findings.title: 44 images have no width or height
findings.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
findings.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
findings.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 2.9 s (needs improvement), Interaction to Next Paint 130 ms (good), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.26 (poor). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
findings.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners. Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts.

findings.title: Lighthouse scores performance 47/100 on mobile
findings.evidence: Lighthouse 13.6.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 11.7 s, Total Blocking Time 62 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.246, Speed Index 6.6 s.
findings.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

findings.title: 3 front-end libraries have known flaws
findings.evidence: prettyPhoto 3.1.5 (banner of /static/js/jquery.prettyPhoto.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated high. Bootstrap 3.0.3 (banner of /static/js/bootstrap.min.js): 8 known flaws, the worst rated medium, such as CVE-2018-20676, CVE-2018-20677, CVE-2018-14040. jQuery 1.10.2 (banner of /static/js/jquery.js): 5 known flaws, the worst rated medium, such as CVE-2015-9251, CVE-2019-11358, CVE-2020-11023. Checked against the retire.js list of 2026-10-22.
findings.fix: Upgrade prettyPhoto to 3.1.6 or later; move Bootstrap off 3.x, which gets no more fixes; upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

findings.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
findings.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
findings.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

findings.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
findings.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 1 profile that could go in sameAs.
findings.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

findings.title: The domain receives mail but publishes no SPF record
findings.evidence: automationexercise.com has MX records and no v=spf1 TXT record. Anyone can send mail that claims to be from it.
findings.fix: Publish an SPF record that lists the services that send your mail.

findings.title: No DMARC policy
findings.evidence: _dmarc.automationexercise.com has no v=DMARC1 record. Spoofed mail from this domain is not rejected, and Gmail and Yahoo now expect DMARC from bulk senders.
findings.fix: Start with p=none and a rua address, then move to quarantine or reject.

findings.title: 2 descriptions are shared by more than one page
findings.evidence: "This is for automation practice…" on /, /products, /view_cart and 15 more. "Full-Fledged website for Automation Practice…" on /test_cases, /api_list.
findings.fix: Describe each page on its own.

findings.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
findings.evidence: "Automation Exercise - Dress Products" on /category_products/1, /category_products/4.
findings.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

findings.title: Cumulative Layout Shift got worse for real phone visitors over six months
findings.evidence: Real Chrome users at the 75th percentile, one point per week from May 16, 2026 to Oct 31, 2026. Cumulative Layout Shift on phones on this page: 0.23 to 0.25 (needs improvement to poor) ▇▇▇▇▆▇▇▇████▇█▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇███. Each value is the mean of the first or last four weeks. Source: Chrome UX Report History API.
findings.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners. Look at what shipped in the weeks the line starts to rise.

findings.title: No sitemap was found
findings.evidence: robots.txt names no sitemap, and /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml and /sitemap-index.xml returned no URLs.
findings.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.

findings.title: A missing page answers 200 instead of 404
findings.evidence: A made-up path answered 200 with the title "Automation Exercise". Search engines call this a soft 404 and may index empty pages.
findings.fix: Return status 404 (or 410) for unknown paths, with a helpful page.

findings.title: No privacy notice is linked
findings.evidence: None of the 20 pages analyzed, nor the rendered start page, links a privacy notice, yet the site sets cookies, loads Cloudflare Web Analytics, has 23 forms. Visitors cannot see who handles their data or why.
findings.fix: Publish a privacy notice that names who controls the data, what is collected, why, and the visitor's rights, and link it from the footer of every page.

findings.title: 6 JavaScript errors while loading
findings.evidence: Mixed Content: The page at 'https://automationexercise.com/' was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure stylesheet 'http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto:400,300,400italic,500,700,100'.… | Mixed Content: The page at 'https://automationexercise.com/' was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure stylesheet 'http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Open+Sans:400,800,300,600,700'. This r….
findings.fix: Open the browser console on the start page and fix the errors in order.

items: Mixed Content: The page at 'https://automationexercise.com/' was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure stylesheet 'http://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto:400,300,400italic,500,700,100'.…

findings.title: /llms.txt answers with an HTML page
findings.evidence: The address returns a web page, which usually means a catch-all route.
findings.fix: Serve a plain-text /llms.txt. The fix kit has a draft built from this review.

findings.title: Headers reveal a software version
findings.evidence: Phusion Passenger(R) 6.2.1. Version numbers make it easier to match known flaws.
findings.fix: Hide version numbers (server_tokens off, expose_php = Off).

findings.title: 1 script host is loaded without integrity checks
findings.evidence: pagead2.googlesyndication.com. If that CDN is compromised, its code runs on the site.
findings.fix: Add integrity="sha384-…" and crossorigin="anonymous" to fixed-version CDN scripts.

findings.title: No security.txt
findings.evidence: /.well-known/security.txt returned 404. Researchers who find a flaw have no published way to report it.
findings.fix: Publish /.well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires. The fix kit has a draft.

findings.title: No CAA record limits who may issue certificates
findings.evidence: automationexercise.com has no CAA record, so any certificate authority may issue for it.
findings.fix: Add a CAA record for the authority you use, for example 0 issue "letsencrypt.org".

findings.title: No TLS-RPT address receives reports of failed secure deliveries
findings.evidence: _smtp._tls.automationexercise.com has no v=TLSRPTv1 record, so nobody hears when senders cannot deliver mail over TLS.
findings.fix: Publish TXT "v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:tlsrpt@automationexercise.com" at _smtp._tls.automationexercise.com.

findings.title: The start page sends no cache-control
findings.evidence: Browsers and CDNs guess how long to keep it.
findings.fix: Send cache-control on HTML (for example max-age=0, must-revalidate) and long max-age on hashed assets.

findings.title: No structured data was found
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD block was found on the pages that were analyzed.
findings.fix: Add Organization or Person, WebSite, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. The fix kit has a draft.

findings.title: No content is shaped as questions and answers
findings.evidence: No heading on the pages analyzed is a question and no FAQ data was found. AI answers favour short, direct answers under a question.
findings.fix: Add an FAQ block with the questions customers ask, answered in two or three sentences each.

findings.title: Pages do not say who wrote them or when they were updated
findings.evidence: Author and date signals help search engines and AI answers judge whether a page is current and credible.
findings.fix: Show an author and a last-updated date on content pages, and add them to the JSON-LD.

findings.title: No MTA-STS policy protects mail sent to the domain
findings.evidence: automationexercise.com receives mail but publishes no _mta-sts TXT record. Sending servers fall back to unencrypted delivery if an attacker on the path strips STARTTLS.
findings.fix: Publish an MTA-STS policy in mode: testing with a TLS-RPT address, then move to enforce once reports are clean.

findings.title: The main heading appears only after JavaScript
findings.evidence: "AutomationExercise" is on the rendered page but not in the HTML.
findings.fix: Put the h1 in the server HTML.

findings.title: 3 indexable pages carry fewer than 150 words in the HTML
findings.evidence: /view_cart (51 words), /login (50 words), /contact_us (94 words).
findings.fix: Add useful copy, merge thin pages, or mark them noindex.

findings.title: Whether an accessibility statement is required needs a person
findings.evidence: None of the 20 pages analyzed, nor the rendered start page, links an accessibility statement, and the review saw no shop. The European Accessibility Act requires one from shops and from services such as banking, transport and e-books sold to consumers in the EU, and EU public-sector sites need one too.

findings.title: The time budget ended before every page was analyzed
findings.evidence: 20 pages of 20 were analyzed. Slow responses use up the budget.

findings.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
findings.evidence: 19 linked pages answered without an error.

findings.title: Every page has a title
findings.evidence: 20 pages checked.

findings.title: Every page has a meta description
findings.evidence: 20 pages checked.

findings.title: The start page sets a mobile viewport
findings.evidence: A viewport meta tag is present.

findings.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
findings.evidence: No robots.txt rules were found, so every crawler is allowed by default.

findings.title: The start page reads well without JavaScript
findings.evidence: 5353 characters of text are in the HTML.

findings.title: 1 measurement tool was found
findings.evidence: Cloudflare Web Analytics.

findings.title: Campaign parameters survive the redirects
findings.evidence: A visit with utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign kept them on /?utm_source=qa-lab-review&utm_medium=audit&utm_campaign=redirect-check.

findings.title: Plain http redirects permanently to https
findings.evidence: http:// answered 301 to https://automationexercise.com/.

findings.title: Framing is limited
findings.evidence: X-Frame-Options: DENY.

findings.title: Cross-origin isolation is not requested
findings.evidence: COOP: absent. COEP: absent. CORP: absent. The browser reported crossOriginIsolated false. COEP is only needed by pages that use SharedArrayBuffer or precise timers.

findings.title: The TLS certificate is valid for 44 more days
findings.evidence: Valid until 2026-12-16, issued by Google Trust Services.

findings.title: Google's Safe Browsing lists do not flag the site
findings.evidence: The Web Risk API found https://automationexercise.com/ on no malware, phishing or unwanted-software list.

findings.title: The domain is registered for 297 more days
findings.evidence: automationexercise.com, held with GoDaddy.com, LLC, is registered until 2027-08-26.

findings.title: The domain is locked against transfer
findings.evidence: The RDAP status of automationexercise.com includes client transfer prohibited.

findings.title: Every image has an alt attribute
findings.evidence: No image without alt was found.

findings.title: The start page declares its language
findings.evidence: lang="en".

findings.title: The start page arrived in 732 ms
findings.evidence: Under the 800 ms budget for the HTML.

findings.title: Nothing on the page blocks the back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Back restored the start page from the cache.

findings.title: No browser fingerprinting was seen
findings.evidence: Before any choice, no script read back a canvas with text on it, measured 50 or more fonts, read the graphics card name, or rendered a silent audio tone.

findings.title: Typing in a form sends nothing before submit
findings.evidence: The review typed a test address into the "Your email address" field without submitting, and no other site received it. Scripts from static.cloudflareinsights.com, pagead2.googlesyndication.com, googleads.g.doubleclick.net listen to typing on the page.

findings.title: The page fits a 390 px phone screen
findings.evidence: No sideways scroll in a phone-sized Chromium window.

findings.title: The page fits a 768 px tablet screen
findings.evidence: No sideways scroll at tablet width.

findings.title: The HTML carries the text people see
findings.evidence: The start page HTML holds 100% of the words on the rendered page.

findings.title: The largest element paints in 1.9 s
findings.evidence: Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower.

findings.title: The layout holds still while loading
findings.evidence: Cumulative Layout Shift 0.005. Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower.
